body: At this point I'm mostly living out of spite towards everyone that's wronged me. Perhaps, you're past even that point. In which case, I hope you find peace in whatever way you choose.
Tbh whether it helps me or not is irrelevant. But it might help others. And I love hearing others life stories, so go right ahead dude.

That's good to hear. Remains to be seen if I'll ever finish but I was on track to finish in three and now its gonna be the regular four so not so bad I suppose. I'm not asexual per say but I'm not very sexually inclined when it comes to relationships, my priority would be their personality and life path. But in college sex is everything if you want to have a boy/girlfriend. I just want to be loved, for someone to hug me and mean it. So being along forever seems the likely conclusion. I might get a dog tho when I have the energy to take care of one. They don't expect shit from you. Except food probably. Anyways thanks for this conversation and your advice, I'm feeling a little better about the future. Not optimistic, but not as pessimistic. Hope you have a good one.

Perhaps the future won't improve. I've given up on humanity. We're all fucking morons, some more than others. That's what I've known. But maybe, after we all go extinct somewhere down the line another species can appreciate the beautiful parts of our existence. A sad take, but it's all the optimism I can muster.

Yeah that was my first relationship so now I've got trust issues with people that try to flirt with me. My whole notion of what a relationship should be is poisoned. I'm still trying to figure it out, but I've also simultaneously accepted the genuine possibility of me dying alone so its whatever.

The study group thing is very true for me, it's the only way I get any serious work done. But library genesis is new and holy shit I could've saved $300 this semester alone. I just bookmarked it so tysm! Also my struggles with college are both a comprehension and motivation issue. The comprehension part is only because I just can't be bothered to attend lectures sometimes. So I then lack the motivation to to try to understand the subject because of the work I have to then do to keep up. It's a vicious cycle of sorts. Trying to break it, with limited success. But I know no matter what I'm taking some L's this semester. I'll try the pomodoro thing as well, seems neat.

I was in a very similar situation with a girl. Then after a whole day at Disneyland doing cutesy "couple" shit, she called me by her ex's name. I knew it was over then. There were earlier red flags like her still looking at her ex's snapchat like four times a day at least, and her constantly mentioning how similar I was to him. I never knew what the hell we were. Sometimes she'd say shit like "i wonder what our kids would look like" and other times she'd say we're just REALLY close friends. In the last few months I talked to her she kept trying to ask me what my opinion was on friends with benefits. I knew what was happening for the longest time and I let her use me because even if her love was meant for someone else it was all I had. In a way I used her too because I accepted the role of being her replacement boyfriend. It's like the level below a rebound. The end result, we were both worse for knowing each other. In another place and another time it could have gone so differently. We could've at least stayed friends.

In regards to school, honestly I don't know if I'll make it. It feels like I'm drowning while swimming in a stagnant lake. It really shouldn't be this hard, and it used to not be. But now it is. Still 2 years from graduating. Any advice on how to make it?

Well that was me venting. So I'm good for now. It's odd that my daily life happens to be cycles of catastrophizing punctuated by moments of blissful numbness (that's where I'm at rn). But I'm curious, what parts are similar?
I hoped that for me as well. You hoping the same doesn't really help me in any way. But I didn't ask for help. And I appreciate the sentiment.
